With antecedents in the stupa and rock-cut types of architecture, temples have been central to India’s cultural life for many centuries.
Whether Buddhist, Jain or Hindu, temples have been places of worship, but also of learning, literature, art (sculpture, dance, music, painting among others).
Besides, they were centres of social intercourse and economic life.
Architecturally, they evolved into works of art that celebrate life and encourage bhakti as well as quiet contemplation.
Classical temples emerged during the Gupta era.
Many were built thanks to royal patronage, as evidenced by inscriptions, but also by endowments from various donors.
Temple construction followed principles and techniques spelt out in treatises of śhilpaśhāstra — the discipline of arts and crafts, largely dedicated to architecture and sculpture.

measurement_notes.pages: Encountered = doc.numPages from pdf.js. Accepted = pages whose extractPageLayout bodyText length > 30, exactly the batch condition; per-page chars/blocks recorded from the layout result. Pages below threshold are listed with char counts.
measurement_notes.sections_paragraphs: From Engine.parseRawDocument via analyzeSource: sections are page-marker/heading flushes; paragraphs are blank-line flushes. Titles are the raw section titles.
measurement_notes.facts: From analyzeSource return (extractSourceFacts + detectFactConflicts). by_relation tallies the raw relation string. candidate_count per fact counts production candidates whose evidence.fact_ids include the fact; multi/AR/matching/chronology/table candidates are counted only if they list the fact in evidence.fact_ids.
measurement_notes.candidates_by_subtype: Wrapper-observed: independent buildQuestionCandidates call with the same ctx/options generateQuestionBank uses. Cross-check: wrapper production_candidates_total must equal generation.productionCandidates; if it differs, the wrapper diverged and production metrics win.
measurement_notes.rejections_by_rule: Production rejectionCounts (first validation issue only, plus buildMetrics buckets, selection buckets, v2_ prefixed V2 counts) are reported verbatim under production_path_generation_metrics. Wrapper counts are separate: first-issue (production tally method) and all-issues tallies from validateQuestion per candidate. A candidate can carry several validation issues; only the first enters the production tally.
measurement_notes.lack_of_valid_distractors: NOT directly exposed as its own count. Two proxies, kept separate: (1) buildMetrics.missingOptions — direct makers returning null for any reason (missing distractors included, not distinguished); (2) wrapper validation issues on distractor rules (distractor_provenance, fragment_distractor, option_uniqueness, option_count). Neither proxy equals "rejected because they lack valid distractors" on its own.
measurement_notes.selection_loss: See selection_loss_decomposition.separation_note. Dedup vs relation-reuse vs subtype-cap vs target-cap are inseparable from exposed metrics.
measurement_notes.v2_candidates_by_subtype: Pre-validation V2 candidate subtypes are NOT exposed (neither batch step nor internal V2 run exposes rejected V2 candidates by subtype); only accepted V2 questions by subtype are reported, plus V2 validation rejection codes from generation metrics.
measurement_notes.determinism: analyzeSource was run twice on identical input; identical stem/subtype/key/option signatures mean the pipeline is deterministic for this input, so any non-reproduction of the production 5 is attributable to code/input differences since the bank was generated, not randomness.
not_measured: Per-fact builder failure reason (which maker check failed for a specific fact) — buildQuestionCandidates returns only aggregate buildMetrics.
Which specific facts the multi/AR/matching/chronology/table builders considered and discarded — those builders return only surviving candidates, with no discard trace.
Internal-V2 rejected candidates by subtype or per-candidate reason beyond the V2 rejection-code counts in generation metrics.
